comment: When the actual price is revealed for products using a Minimum Advertised Price.
modal: Chooses where the real price is shown instead of the MAP: **On Gesture** (after a click/popup), **In Cart**, or **Before Order Confirmation**. Can differ per website.

comment: The default text shown in the MAP price popup.
modal: The message displayed in the popup that explains why the actual price is hidden for Minimum Advertised Price products. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: The default text shown in the MAP "What's This" popup.
modal: The message displayed in the "What's This" popup linked from Minimum Advertised Price products. Can differ per website or store view.
